name: yf_index_history
description:
Daily history for one market index from Yahoo Finance.
Returns: {index, data_points (total days), prices: the first (oldest) 100 days, each {Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Dividends, Stock Splits}}; with the default 1y period the most recent months are cut off, so a shorter period gives the latest data.
Inputs (* required): index* (Yahoo index symbol, e.g. ^GSPC, ^DJI, ^IXIC, ^RUT; default ^GSPC); period (1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1y, 5y, ytd, max, ...; default 1y).
Up to 500 bars: yf_stock_history with the index symbol; latest levels: yf_market_summary. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"index": "^IXIC", "period": "3mo"}
